summary_1line: Narada recounts King Gaya’s extreme devotion, vast sacrifices, and lavish gifts, showing that even such righteous kings ultimately died.

image_candidates.scene_text: Agni appears before the ascetic king Gaya amid the sacrificial fire and grants him the boons he requests.
A colossal golden sacrificial altar thirty yojanas long, glittering with pearls and gems, stands surrounded by priests and offerings.
After the sacrifice, immense hills of food and lakes of drink remain untouched around the golden altar.
